content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Qualifications must be recognised by Board of Technical Education/University.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing in or awaiting the result of the qualifying exam. Candidates without mark sheets and degree/diploma certificate (provisional or final). Candidates previously engaged as apprentice, or currently undergoing apprenticeship training at NMP or elsewhere.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Graduate in Civil Engineering. Pay: Rs.12300. Qualification required: Graduate in Mechanical Engineering. Pay: Rs.12300. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Apprenticeship is for one year only and ends on completion. NMPA gives no commitment of permanent or temporary employment after training.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All semester certificates Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC copy)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given in the notice (separate formats for graduate engineering and for diploma). Attach all semester certificates and caste certificate. Address the application to the Asst. Secretary (PAC), Administration Department, NMPA, Panambur, on or before 05-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who passed the qualifying exam in 2024, 2025 and 2026 only need to apply (the introduction also mentions 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The application form must carry the verification signature of the concerned office.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 vacancies: 3 Graduate Apprentice in Civil, 5 Graduate Apprentice in Mechanical, 4 Graduate Apprentice in Electrical, 3 Graduate Apprentice in B.A, 1 Graduate Apprentice in B.Com, 1 Diploma Apprentice in Computer Science and 4 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application formats on pages 3 and 4 of the notice) and send it to Asst. Secretary (PAC), Administration Department, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur - 575010, by post, to reach by 5 November 2026.
